summary: @or-sdk/web-search preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727 KB sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime (bun v1.3.13) from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it solely to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js (727 KB). math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (string-array rotation via WV8StW, hex-identifier renaming, numeric-charcode string table hc1jfK9) and is not reachable through the package's declared main entry, so it is executed only as a side effect of installation. The advertised purpose is a web-search SDK, which does not require a second language runtime or an obfuscated init blob. Using an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle at install time bypasses conventional Node-based review of what the code actually does. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: an npm preinstall pulls in an out-of-band interpreter and hands it opaque code that runs on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
